other.waitingDetail: They haven't set off yet. This page updates by itself — no need to touch anything.
other.stoppedDetail: Stopped for {{minutes}} min. Setting off now, they'd arrive around {{time}}.

own.waitingDetail: Step out under open sky so the GPS can find you.
own.stoppedDetail: Stopped for {{minutes}} min. Setting off now, you'd arrive around {{time}}.

hero.noSignalDetail: No signal from their phone (last position {{ago}}). Time based on the last we know.
hero.lowConfidence: First estimate — it sharpens as they go.
hero.endedDetail: Their location is no longer stored or shown.

map.label: Topographic map with the live position

stalledStopped.title: {{name}} hasn't moved for {{minutes}} min
stalledStopped.body: Their last position is on the map. It may just be a long break — try calling them.

stalledNoSignal.title: No news from {{name}} for {{minutes}} min
stalledNoSignal.body: Their phone isn't sending its position. In the mountains that's usually no coverage. The last known position is on the map.

viewer.offRoute: They're off the planned route; the arrival time may change.
viewer.notFoundBody: It may have expired or been copied wrong. Ask whoever sent it to share a new one.
viewer.errorBody: Check your connection. We keep trying…

home.title: Let them know when you'll arrive.
home.subtitle: Share your mountain outing with a link. Whoever is waiting sees where you are and an arrival time that accounts for the climbing, not just the distance.
home.name: Your name
home.gpxHint: With a GPX route the arrival time is far more accurate: we know how much climb and descent is left.
home.routeNoElevation: {{distance}} · this GPX has no altitudes, so the time will be less accurate
home.pointHint: Tap the map to mark your destination.
home.pointSet: Destination set. Tap elsewhere to change it.
home.stallValue: Alert my followers if I haven't moved for {{minutes}} min
home.demoHint: Simulates a descent from Pedraforca to Gósol so you can try it from your sofa.
home.privacy: No accounts. A secret link that expires by itself. Stop sharing whenever you want and your location is erased.

errors.destinationRequired: Choose a GPX route or mark a destination on the map.
errors.gpx_invalid: That file doesn't look like a valid GPX.
errors.gpx_too_large: The file is too large (5 MB maximum).
errors.too_many_sessions: You've created too many sessions. Wait a while.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

run.shareTitle: Send this link to whoever is waiting
run.shareText: Follow my route live and see when I'll arrive:
run.screenBody: Leave this page open and visible. If you lock the phone or switch apps, the browser stops sending your position.
run.screenLocked: We keep the screen on for you while this page is open.
run.screenUnsupported: This browser can't keep the screen on: turn off auto-lock in your phone settings.
run.bufferBody: {{count}} positions saved on the phone. They'll be sent automatically when signal returns.
run.gpsDeniedBody: Allow location access for this page in your browser settings and reload.
run.gpsUnavailableBody: Step out under open sky. We keep trying.
run.gpsUnsupportedBody: Open the page on a phone with location services.
run.demoNotice: Demo mode: the position is simulated and sped up.
run.stopConfirmBody: The link will stop showing your position and we'll erase your location right now.
run.finishedBody: The link will keep showing that you arrived for one hour, then everything is deleted.
